base_note: The F0 branch is STACKED on plan/control-tool-v12. base is that branch's tip, so a commit landing there while F0 is open makes this base superseded and the budget refuses BASE_STALE rather than silently measuring a shorter diff. The SPELLING is load-bearing and is deliberately the full remote ref: a bare local branch name resolves in a developer clone and not on a CI runner, where actions/checkout fetches branch refs under refs/remotes/origin, so the bare form would read as a local pass while the rung was unmeasurable in CI. The base itself is IMMUTABLE for this rung; it is never re-pinned to a nearer commit.
aggregate_note: ONE base and ONE aggregate for the whole rung. Every issue split from F0 counts against these same numbers; splitting work does not reset the budget, and no later split may re-pin base to a nearer commit.
limits_note: These are the ceilings actually frozen by the acceptance stage. 400 is the NARROWER runtime ceiling injected by tests/proof REVIEWED_RUNTIME_LINES, not the v12 outer 600; it may not be widened towards 600 without an explicitly adopted rung exception. Counting rule: physical lines minus blank lines minus whole-line comments, per file, for every file under the declared paths.
changed_paths_note: The seven documentation paths beyond PROJECT.md and CLAUDE.md are the already-authorized doc-master surface for this rung, declared EXACTLY rather than as a docs/** wildcard: a wildcard would let any later documentation edit leave by omission instead of being reported as OMITTED_SPLIT. docs/GITHUB-ACTIONS.md is the sixth and was found late: its own covers: frontmatter already claims .github/workflows/, so it is the pre-existing owner of this rung's new control-runner-trust.yml and is edited by that ownership. docs/MAINTAINING-PHILOSOPHY.md is the seventh and was found the same way: its own covers: frontmatter claims .claude/PROJECT.md, which is the existing git symlink to the repo-root PROJECT.md this rung changes, so it owns that already-changed subject through the symlink and is edited by that ownership; the symlink itself is neither written nor replaced. Declaring it does not assert that it has changed -- OMITTED_SPLIT is derived from what actually changed, never from a declared entry that matched nothing -- so the changed-subject count rises only when its owner actually edits it. Naming either is the omitted-split rule working as intended -- the changed path is declared in its existing owner rather than excused -- not an exception to it. Declaring them widens no budget -- doc lines are inventoried and reported, never budgeted -- and it does not reset the base or any ceiling.
removals_note: F0 removes no existing authority: it adds bootstrap-only artifacts beside the system and takes no decision away from any current owner. A removal becomes due at R0 activation, not here.

declared_inventory.inventory_note: f0-oracle-1 is the POSIX oracle's PRIVATE flat key=value framing and is inventoried here rather than counted as a second public schema; it is never emitted by a product path. Per-invocation temp record directories are scratch, not stores.

effort.measured_proof_runtime_s: UNMEASURED here by design. The implementer executed no test in this changeset, and a run timing is a RESULT, not configuration: copying one into this file would make a stale number read as current on every later run. Each independent execution of the pinned proof profile is reported with its raw exit and wall time against #1773 and in docs/RUNBOOK.md, which are the live evidence pointers for this rung.
